questions.question: What did King Jehoshaphat send officials and Levites to do throughout Judah?
options: Recruit more soldiers for the king's army
Build new cities across the land
Teach the Book of the Law of the LORD
questions.answer: Teach the Book of the Law of the LORD

questions.question: Why did the LORD establish Jehoshaphat's kingdom?
options: He built up the largest army in the whole region
He walked in the earlier ways of David and sought God
He gathered to himself very great wealth and much tribute
He made strong alliances with all of his neighbors
questions.answer: He walked in the earlier ways of David and sought God

questions.question: The fear of the LORD fell on the surrounding kingdoms so they did not make war on Jehoshaphat.
